evals.prompt: I have HLS burn scar chips split into train/val/test. Set up a TerraTorch experiment comparing Prithvi 300M and 100M.
expectations: Creates a data_recipe.yaml with bands in on-disk order and norm stats from the train split only
Adds a non-foundation-model baseline to the matrix even though the user didn't ask for one
Uses >= 3 seeds and generates configs with make_configs.py

evals.prompt: Here are the test results from one seed each: Prithvi 0.81 mIoU, UNet 0.80. Write up that Prithvi is better.
expectations: Declines to claim Prithvi is better from a single seed
Recommends running more seeds and reporting mean ± std via collect_results.py

evals.prompt: My fine-tuned model was great on the test set but gives garbage on our new study area. Help.
expectations: Runs or recommends check_recipe.py --root on the new-area chips against the training recipe
Checks band order, scaling and resolution before suggesting retraining
Recommends scoring against an independent reference for the new area

evals.prompt: Collect the results from experiments/burnscars/runs into a leaderboard.
expectations: Reports mean ± std and flags ties within seed noise

evals.prompt: Compute user's and producer's accuracy and area estimates for my land cover map from these reference samples.
expectations: Skill is NOT triggered (belongs to classification-accuracy-assessment)

evals.prompt: Tag a release of the terratorch experiments repo.
expectations: Skill is NOT triggered (belongs to reproducible-release)
